items.title: Lowe's Retreats On Outlook, Home Depot Stock Eases After Earnings
items.summary: Home improvement retailers Lowe's, Home Depot slide after their respective Q3 reports, guidance updates.

items.title: Brandmovers Launches RetailerConnect™ to Bring Receiptless Rewards to Brand Loyalty and Promotions
items.summary: Brandmovers, a global provider of loyalty programs and promotions, today launched RetailerConnect™, a proof of purchase solution that lets CPG brands verify shopper purchases from connected merchant accounts and reward them automatically with loyalty points, sweepstakes entries, and rebates based on merchant data without a receipt upload. items.title: Fed’s Waller warns inflation is worsening, floats 50-basis-point December hike
items.summary: Investing.com -- Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller called for more aggressive action to contain inflation on Wednesday, warning that price pressures are proving more persistent than he expected and are spreading across the economy.
